purpose: Measure the remaining CPU rANS stages and overlap I-frame CPU entropy coding with GPU synthesis without changing the codec or bitstream.

instrumentation.disabled_cost: The scope avoids clock reads and string allocation unless --profile is enabled.

profile_diagnostic.clock_note: interactive unlocked-clock diagnostic, not release evidence
profile_diagnostic.conclusion: Orin I-frame execution is GPU-compute-bound. CPU entropy is still large enough to hide behind synthesis for a measurable encode gain. This result must not be generalized to RTX without measurement.

scheduling_change: After entropy D2H copies and their readiness event are queued, enqueue I-frame synthesis on the same CUDA stream. Synchronize only the readiness event, perform CPU rANS while synthesis executes, then let reconstruction download synchronize final completion.

isolated_540p_results.protocol: BasketballDrive, 97 frames, QP32, dynamic 720p bundle, A-B-B-A-A-B, unlocked clocks; CUDA Graphs excluded by area cap

gop97.decision: no regression; expected diluted gain because only the I-frame overlaps

decision: Retain entropy instrumentation and I-frame CPU/GPU overlap. Repeat under locked clocks and measure separately on RTX before changing any desktop-specific policy.
